profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer | Payment Platform | Walmart Global Tech
profile.summary: At Walmart Global Tech, we're pushing the boundaries of e-commerce with cutting-edge solutions. As a Senior Software Engineer with over 15 years in the tech industry, my expertise in Java and big data technologies like Apache Kafka and Spark has been pivotal. Previously, as a Software Architect at Amdocs, I honed these skills to architect robust software solutions. My mission aligns with Walmart's—to innovate and deliver exceptional value—and my work reflects a commitment to this, leveraging my competencies to enhance system efficiencies and user experiences. My approach is collaborative, ensuring our team's efforts contribute to the company's leading edge in the retail & e-commerce space.
